correctness.rationale: Stationary sign symmetry and independent synchronous conditional copying imply a three-orbit covariance system with cross-part covariance zero and y=(qb+q^2(a-1))/(ab-q^2(a-1)(b-1)). The complete-bipartite random-walk kernel alternates uniform mass across the two parts, giving exact odd-zero and even-geometric root lag correlations. At epsilon=1/2, y=(a+4b-1)/(15ab+a+b-1), and y(a,b)=1/(3n+1) is equivalent to (5a-4n-1)b=n(a-1). Substituting a=1+j(n-1), b=jn/(5j-4) proves equality. n=2*lcm(5j-4, j=1..k) ensures all b are integers >=2. Strictly increasing larger bipartition classes imply pairwise nonisomorphism. Full unordered-vertex-pair stationary systems were separately solved by exact rational code for small collisions; verifier reports 560 passing assertions. Finite checks do not replace symbolic proof.
